api-py: Python + FastAPI + Pydantic HTTP API. Async, httpx outbound, OpenAPI authoritative. No DB layer assumed.
api-ts: Node + Hono + Zod HTTP API. No DB layer assumed; storage and queues behind external adapters.
backend-ts: Node + Hono + Drizzle + Postgres service. Optional SQS/Redis worker section.
combo-ts-python: React + Vite frontend (web/) and FastAPI backend (api/) with OpenAPI-generated TS client.
data-py: Python data pipelines: ingest->transform->publish. Optional Databricks and dbt sections.
frontend-ts: React + Vite + Tailwind SPA. No backend in this repo.
fullstack-ts: One repo, src/{client,server,shared}, React + Hono with shared Zod contracts.
library-py: Published Python package or CLI. uv + ruff + ty + pytest + hatchling.
library-ts: Published TS package or CLI. ESM, tsc-only, Changesets, optional bin.
python: uv + ruff + ty + pytest. pydantic-settings entry, dataclasses internal, pydantic at boundaries.
